description: This PHP source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Encoder, which provides static methods for UTF-8 character encoding, string cleaning, and iconv-based conversions, including workarounds for iconv bugs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Encoder
classes.description: A static class providing methods for UTF-8 encoding, string cleaning, and iconv bug workarounds.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: A static method that mutes errors, used as a callback for set_error_handler.

methods.name: unsafeIconv
methods.description: Wraps iconv with error handling to suppress errors during conversion.

methods.name: iconv
methods.description: Performs iconv conversion with bug workarounds, splitting into chunks if necessary.

methods.name: cleanUTF8
methods.description: Cleans a UTF-8 string for well-formedness and SGML validity, removing invalid codepoints.

methods.name: unichr
methods.description: Converts a Unicode codepoint into its UTF-8 character representation.

methods.name: iconvAvailable
methods.description: Checks if iconv is available and not buggy.

methods.name: convertToUTF8
methods.description: Converts a string to UTF-8 based on configuration, handling various encodings.

methods.name: convertFromUTF8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string from UTF-8 to another encoding based on configuration.

methods.name: convertToASCIIDumbLossless
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to ASCII with numeric entities for non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: testIconvTruncateBug
methods.description: Tests for known iconv truncation bugs.

methods.name: testEncodingSupportsASCII
methods.description: Checks if a given encoding supports ASCII characters.
